description: Curated map of famous narrations that appear in more than one major collection, with their cross-collection references. Used by the Hadith Research Agent to trace variant narrations and to reconcile citations that name different numbers for the same hadith.
provenance: Every (collection, number) pair was verified against the text of the pinned fawazahmed0/hadith-api edition files used to build data/hadith/*.json, so each reference resolves through the bundled grading dataset. Narration titles are one-line glosses, not reproductions of translated texts.

variants.title: Actions are by intentions
variants.narration: The reward of deeds depends on intentions, and every person will have what they intended.

variants.title: None of you believes until he loves for his brother
variants.narration: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

variants.title: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe
variants.narration: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.

variants.title: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear
variants.narration: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between them are doubtful matters.

variants.title: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim
variants.narration: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.

variants.title: My mercy prevails over My wrath
variants.narration: When Allah completed the creation, He wrote with Him: 'My mercy prevails over My wrath.'

references.note: First hadith of the Forty Hadith Qudsi

variants.title: The believers are like one body
variants.narration: The similitude of believers in mutual love, mercy and affection is like one body.
